heading: side
name: 側欄標題＋單列等寬方圖網格
desc: 左側窄欄放標題，右側多個無外框項目等寬並排成一列，每項方形圖片在上、小標籤與標題在下。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。標題組放在左側一欄，約佔兩成多的寬度，在欄內水平置中，並垂直置中於右側項目的高度；標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略。右側約七成多是多個項目排成的網格，所有項目等寬並排成一列，靠上對齊，同一列等高。每個項目無外框：方形圖片在上，同一組圖片都是方形；圖片下方是一排小標籤，再下方是標題（可多行）。
mobile: 標題組移到區塊上方並置中；項目網格改為直向堆疊，每列一個項目、橫跨內容寬度，每個項目仍是方形圖片在上、小標籤與標題在下。

en.name: Side-column heading with a single-row grid of equal-width square-image items
en.desc: A narrow left column holds the heading, while multiple unframed items sit side by side in one row of equal width, each with a square image above and a label and title below.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group in a side column on the left, taking a little over two tenths of the width, centered horizontally within the column and vertically centered against the height of the items on the right; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description and button below; omit them when there is no content. The right side, a little over seven tenths of the width, is a grid of multiple items, all of equal width placed side by side in a single row, top-aligned and of equal height within the row. Each item has no frame: a square image on top, with every image in the set square; below the image is a row of labels, and below that a title (may wrap to multiple lines).
en.mobile: The heading group moves to the top of the section and is centered; the grid changes to a vertical stack with one item per row spanning the content width, each item still a square image on top with the labels and title below.
